title: Full Stack Development Trainer
description:

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

Gandhi Nagar, Gujarat

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer who can own complex features end-to-end, drive technical decisions, and ensure scalability, security, and performance across the stack. You will work closely with architects, product owners, and junior engineers to deliver high-quality solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Architecture & Design
  

* Design and evolve RESTful API contracts using Swagger/OpenAPI
* Define backend microservices architecture and frontend modular design
* Ensure solutions scale for performance, security, and maintainability

Backend Development
  

* Build and maintain services using Java (8+/17), Spring Boot
* Implement Spring Security with OAuth2/OIDC/JWT
* Design and optimize databases, queries, and indexing strategies
* Implement asynchronous communication using Kafka / RabbitMQ
* Write clean, testable, and production-grade code

Frontend Development
  

* Build scalable UI using React, TypeScript
* Use advanced React patterns (Hooks, Context, React Query/Redux)
* Optimize frontend performance (lazy loading, memoization, CRP optimization)
* Ensure accessibility, responsiveness, and cross-browser compatibility
* Write test cases using jest

DevOps & Cloud
  

* Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/GitLab)
* Containerize applications using Docker and deploy via Kubernetes
* Work with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) for application deployment
* Ensure observability using logs, metrics, and monitoring tools

Quality & Leadership
  

* Drive automated testing across the stack
* Conduct rigorous code reviews and enforce best practices
* Mentor junior developers and guide technical implementations
* Collaborate in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Required Skills (Must-Have)
  
Backend
  

* Strong expertise in Java 8+/17 & Spring Boot
* Spring Security (OAuth2, JWT, OIDC)
* Microservices architecture
* SQL & database optimization

Frontend
  

* Strong hands-on experience with React & TypeScript
* Advanced understanding of hooks, state management
* Experience integrating APIs and handling async workflows

DevOps & System Design
  

* Docker & Kubernetes
* CI/CD pipelines
* Git-based workflows
* Understanding of distributed systems concepts

Nice to Have (Value Add Skills)
  

* Cloud-native architecture experience
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
* React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright
* GraphQL exposure
* WebSockets / real-time UI updates
* Experience working on high-traffic applications
* Prior experience in mentoring or technical leadership roles

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**About Us**

Maharshi Industries Pvt Ltd (MIPL) is a leader in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, and Virtual Reality Simulation systems, serving Defence, Police, Railways, Oil \& Gas, and Industrial sectors under the *Make in India* initiative. We are seeking a skilled **Full Stack Developer** to design and build advanced **Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs)** for our cutting\-edge **VR and AI\-driven products and platforms**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop **responsive, intuitive GUIs** for VR and AI\-based applications.
* Collaborate with **VR developers, AI engineers, and robotics teams** to integrate backend logic with interactive frontends.
* Build **cross\-platform dashboards** for real\-time data visualization, control, and monitoring of AI/VR systems.
* Develop APIs and middleware to ensure smooth communication between **AI modules, VR simulations, and hardware devices**.
* Optimize applications for **performance, scalability, and security**.
* Participate in **code reviews, testing, and debugging** to maintain high\-quality deliverables.
* Document technical workflows and provide support for integration and deployment.

**Required Skills \& Technologies**

**Frontend Development**

* Strong in **JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3**.
* Experience with modern frameworks: **React.js / Angular / Vue.js**.
* UI/UX design knowledge to build user\-friendly dashboards.

**Backend Development**

* Proficiency in **Node.js, Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI), or Java**.
* Database experience: **MySQL / PostgreSQL / MongoDB**.
* RESTful APIs and WebSocket integration.

**Integration \& Tools**

* Experience with **3D/VR libraries (Three.js, Babylon.js, Unity WebGL integration preferred)**.
* Familiarity with **AI/ML integration workflows** (Python APIs, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or ONNX runtime).
* Knowledge of **Git/GitHub, Docker, CI/CD pipelines**.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical ability.
* Ability to **collaborate with cross\-functional teams** (VR engineers, AI scientists, robotics experts).
* Strong communication skills and ownership of deliverables.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field**.
* Minimum 1–3 years of experience as a **Full Stack Developer.**
* Prior work experience with full stack development is a mandatory.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* 1\. Have you worked on any live projects ?
* 2\. Have you worked on real time protocols?
* 3\. Have you done any integration with external API's ?
* 4\. What is your current on\-hand salary in Lacs per annum?
* 5\. What is your expected on\-hand salary in Lacs per annum?
* 6\. What is your notice period?

Work Location: In person
